verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.newrelic.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 and describes itself as providing clean markdown versions of the docs. Several doc pages are served as .md URLs (e.g., the CLI, SDK, and nrdiag pages), so the docs are directly consumable by agents. Missing for 10: first-party documentation explaining the llms.txt/markdown docs offering and its coverage, plus independent or hands-on reports of agents using it effectively.
